text:
aj: Heads-up — after the automated BMC fw push to us-west-2 (~03:12 UTC) several GPU racks are failing to provision; nodes entering kernel panic during early boot. Suspect Secure Boot NVram bit flipped to enabled on some units. Anyone awake?

maria: paging @sre-oncall @jon. Which fw went out?

deploy-bot: deploy finished: bmc-fw v2.7.1 -> us-west-2 at 2026-03-18T03:12:08Z

sre-oncall: On it. Provision queue spiked 20->95, seeing repeated 'Kernel panic - not syncing: efi: secure boot prevents unsigned module' in dmesg on multiple nodes.

jon: Confirmed. Rack rack-gp2 nodes 01/02/05 show SecureBoot var == 1. BMC nvram dump shows token 'SB_ON=1'. Looks like the fw update wrote the wrong default.

tara: If we can't fix fast we should route new provisioning to eu-west until it's resolved. Cost hit estimate?

luke: quick calc — moving 50 GPUs -> eu-west for 3h ≈ $120/hr incremental, ~ $360 total. Depends on instance types.

maria: Short-term workaround: force signed kernel boot. If you have a signed kernel at /boot/vmlinuz-signed run:

`````
ssh root@node01 'grub-set-default "Signed Kernel" && reboot'
`````

That got node01 past the panic on my test.

aj: runbook check: don't power-cycle more than canary set. Canary nodes: rack-gp2-node01..03. @jon can you rollback fw on node01 as test?

jon: Starting rollback to v2.7.0 on node01 via ipmitool.

ipmi-bot: rollback started: rack-gp2-node01 -> bmc-fw v2.7.0

jon: node01 firmware write OK, rebooting. Node rejoined cluster, provisioning OK.

maria: Nice. I'm halting the rest of the rollout and opening a ticket INFRA-3147: 'BMC fw v2.7.1 writes SecureBoot NVram bit; add preflight nvram check + assertion' <https://issues.internal/INFRA-3147>

sre-oncall: Plan: 1) stop rollout 2) run nvram read on all canaries 3) roll back if SB_ON=1 4) add nvram check to deploy job + add kernel signing to images 5) coordinate with firmware vendor

aj: +1. Also let's notify support and customers with scheduled provisioning in us-west-2. Draft message in #customer-ops

maria: tagging vendor now. @jon can you collect bmc nvram dumps and attach to the ticket? :thumbsup:

jon: Will do. Dump attached to INFRA-3147.

deploy-bot: rollout paused: bmc-fw v2.7.1 -> us-west-2

aj: Good job all — keep updates here. Last status: canary node01 success after rollback; others held.
